description: Save the customer's answers for one step of their application. Fields follow the step's JSON Schema from describe_flow; fields left out keep their saved values. Returns what to fix per field when an answer is refused, in which case nothing was saved.

application_id.description: The application's id (obs_…), from list_applications or start_application.

fields.description: The step's fields, as its JSON Schema in describe_flow describes them.

step.description: The step's key from describe_flow, e.g. "company_details".

name: update_application_step
title: Fill in an application step
